facts.fact: 周六晨回邮件前夫：礼拜六教堂后接走、周一送回学校别迟到
facts.anchor: Pick up the kids after church Saturday. Drop them off at school Monday!

facts.fact: 前夫三分钟后只回 Fine. 6:00 PM.，无道歉无问孩子，像排牙医预约
facts.anchor: The response arrived three minutes later.

facts.fact: 10:00 AM 带三娃游泳：Elizabeth 抗议荧光绿泳衣被要求穿蓝的且必须去
facts.anchor: Yna chuckled softly, checking the clock. It was 10:00 AM.

facts.fact: 滑板场长椅 Elizabeth 劝找想结婚的男人：你写神与黑领主，找普通人应容易
facts.anchor: Then find a man who wants to get married," Elizabeth said simply.

facts.fact: 4:00 PM 到教会：Lynne/Michael 进儿童事工、Elizabeth 青年事工，礼拜是从不缺席的定锚
facts.anchor: By 4:00 PM, they were packed and arriving at church.

facts.fact: 礼拜中回忆：两个男人三个孩子，两次为安全感错觉牺牲理智，独自收场无后援
facts.anchor: Two men. Three children. Two separate times she had compromised her sanity

facts.fact: 散会交娃时退后几步全程避免对视，随后送 Elizabeth 去镇另一头她父亲的家
facts.anchor: Yna stayed several paces back from their father.

facts.fact: 【转折】空屋打开几周前下载的交友软件（匹配无果）又关掉，独自韩餐馆炸鸡配 soju 自嘲孤独
facts.anchor: opened a dating app she had downloaded a few weeks ago
